context: A police officer briefs on sports-event security
purpose: Teach: 勝敗/最下位/制し/打者/飛ばさ/下級/背負う/威厳

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 試合の勝敗、地域感情に響きます。
lines.en: The outcome of a game reverberates through the whole region's mood.
lines.style: Measured, factual opening. Calm professional tone. Steady pace, no rush. Speaks with the quiet authority of someone who has seen how these things unfold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 最下位の試合でも、観客、熱気ありますね。
lines.en: Even games with lower-ranked teams — the crowd brings real heat to it.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, leaning forward slightly. Observant tone. Searching for understanding, not judging. Pace is conversational, almost wondering aloud.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。混乱を制した警備、評価されました。
lines.en: That's right. The security work that prevented things from escalating — it was recognized.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, professional satisfaction without ego. Light emphasis on 「制した」 moment. Even tone, factual. Quiet pride in the work itself, not the praise.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 打者交代の合間、警備、強化されますか。
lines.en: During the batter changes, when there's downtime — do you increase security presence then?
lines.style: Thoughtful question, respectful of the officer's expertise. Gentle curiosity. Pace is unhurried, giving space for a full answer. Checking his own understanding.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。物を飛ばさないよう、観客指導、徹底します。
lines.en: Exactly. We keep strict watch over the crowd so no one throws objects onto the field.
lines.style: Clear, procedural, but with underlying care for safety. Firm on the standards without harshness. Steady pace. The tone of someone explaining not just the rule but why it matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 下級審判への警備、配慮ありますか。
lines.en: Is there special attention paid to the umpires' safety — the lower-ranked ones especially?
lines.style: Respectful, careful phrasing. Genuine concern underneath the politeness. Hesitant rhythm — aware he's asking about something delicate. Soft landing on the question.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。責任を背負う、警察の役割です。
lines.en: That's part of our responsibility. The police shoulder that burden for everyone on the field.
lines.style: Quiet weight of conviction. Speaks slowly, each word deliberate. Not performative — just honest about what the role means. Slight pause before the final phrase, letting it settle.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察官の威厳、現場で感じます。
lines.en: There's a kind of authority you can feel from officers like you, out there in the moment.
lines.style: Reflective, sincere closing. Soft, almost contemplative tone. Genuine observation, not flattery. Pace slows at the end. Respectful, with a note of real admiration.
